title: Still Hot — Tokyo Ramen Sprint
summary: A street ramen chef sprints through a neon Tokyo alley at impossible speed, carrying a full bowl of ramen. She vaults crates, leaps rooftops, garnishes the bowl mid-air and slides across a car, then places it gently on the counter in front of a stunned customer: “Still hot.”
render_stack: ALEXA 65mm anamorphic; 2.39:1; film grain; Dolby Vision HDR
calibration_note: ANCHOR. Impossible action is not a cut. Clip B reference. Re-run at #11, verdict held.

title: Spice Cosmos
summary: A pile of desi spices on a rustic table is lifted by a fingertip. The grains float, ignite and burst outward into a universe made entirely of spice — turmeric nebulae, chilli supernovae, cumin planets — before collapsing back into the pile as if nothing happened.
calibration_note: ANCHOR. Transformation alone is not a cut — the food stays the subject and returns.

title: One Bite Fantasy — Dessert World
summary: A single bite of a chocolate bar fractures reality. The kitchen dissolves into a dessert universe — caramel rivers, cake mountains, cotton-candy clouds — and the character drifts through it, ending on a candy cliff above a glowing sweet landscape.
fix_note: World-dissolve is the make-or-break beat; character consistency inside a full CG world.
calibration_note: ANCHOR. A fantasy world MADE OF THE FOOD keeps, even with no return to reality. Retired the old 'must return' proxy.

title: Neon Dumpling Courier
summary: A courier launches off a noodle-shop awning into a rain-slick rooftop night market, dodging a rival drone swarm with a tower of steaming dumpling baskets. One basket bursts mid-air. He lands at a rooftop table above the city and sets the food down perfectly intact.
calibration_note: Ramen's relative. Sci-fi skin (anti-grav, drones) over a real food-delivery story. Featured food carries it.

title: Awaken — Espresso Matador
summary: A tired man drinks a canned espresso on an Italian cobblestone street, unaware a huge bull is charging behind him. As he drains the can he becomes a matador, dodges the bull with a red cape, then returns to his suit and walks on. The can turns in the light. “Awaken.”
render_stack: cinematic realism; HDR; real shadows/reflections; 480p specified
fix_note: 480p contradicts 'movie-level quality' — raise. Two seamless transforms + strict can-label match are the failure points. Watch the oversized bull: comedic-big, not monstrous.
calibration_note: ANCHOR. A person transforming into a HUMAN ROLE (matador) keeps. Becoming a non-human entity cuts.

title: Alien Donut Heist
summary: A tiny overconfident alien courier steals a giant glowing donut from a spaceship kitchen, escaping a guard drone with a jetpack and a pizza-slice parachute. He crashes into a hatch, sticks the landing, and takes an enormous bite.
calibration_note: Featured food EARNS the home. Donut is the chase object and the payoff; pizza is the parachute. Off-world setting alone does not cut.

title: Sunset Circuit — Driver's Day
summary: A day in the life of a racing driver: waking at seven, breakfast by floor-to-ceiling windows, the drive across the city, the suit zipped, a green GT3 attacking the circuit, the pit-lane walk, a high-five at the garage — and finally, alone at night with a beer, watching it all back.
fix_note: Porsche / PUMA marks named. Logo fidelity is a known AI failure and a rights question if it ships.
calibration_note: ANCHOR. Opened the ASPIRATIONAL route. Premium lifestyle earns a home with no featured dish. Food (eggs, beer) is incidental and that is fine.

title: Rooftop Extraction
summary: A woman in a trench coat runs a rain-slicked rooftop forty storeys above a neon city, pursued by armed operatives. She swings off the ledge into freefall between two skyscrapers, crashes through a skylight, rolls, and disappears into a stairwell without breaking stride.
render_stack: 8K; anamorphic 2.39:1; crushed blacks; Dolby Vision HDR
calibration_note: ANCHOR. Widened the aspirational route — action/thriller intensity qualifies, not just luxury leisure. No food, no venue, still keeps.

title: Main Character Energy
summary: An ordinary day shot like a film trailer: the alarm, the coffee, the commute, the meeting, the rain on the pavement — every mundane beat given weight and slow motion, ending on a rooftop above the skyline at sunset.
render_stack: ultra cinematic realism; lens flares; film-grade grade
fix_note: Weak, generic prompt. Likely nobody's favourite. Real-world and brand-safe, so it holds a place in the library. Upgrade at intake via the motion/emotion script if a client engages.
calibration_note: Tests the ASPIRATIONAL FLOOR — and there isn't one. Keeps on mood alone. Tagged low-distinctiveness so it never leads a selection. Re-run at #25, verdict held.

title: The Storm That Is Approaching
summary: A bionic warrior escapes a drowned city, strikes a rescue beacon and tears open a portal into blazing noon. She lands in an ancient Eastern food market, sprints between fruit stalls and hanging spice, then turns to face what followed her into the alley.
render_stack: 4K cinematic realism; handheld throughout; hyperreal water physics
fix_note: Carries genuinely dark content (zombies, blood). Kept because the food market is a real home and the clip is strong — but its status depends on the Halloween/occasion rule, which is NOT SET.
calibration_note: ANCHOR (paired with the volcanic cut). Dark surface + real food home = keep. Dark surface + no home = cut. Darkness was never the trigger; the home is.

title: Eid Mubarak — Desert Light
summary: Dawn over the dunes as a family prepares for Eid. Robes and jewellery, a walk beside the camels, a feast of dates and tea laid on carpets, greetings under lanterns, prayer at the desert mosque, fireworks over the sand, and a crescent moon above the dunes.
fix_note: Arabic calligraphy title card is a known AI text-render failure. Overlay in post.
calibration_note: First cultural-moment keeper. Both routes open: featured Eid feast (direct) + traditional luxury aesthetic (aspirational).

title: Wuhan — River City
summary: The camera pushes through the steam of a bowl of hot dry noodles and cuts hard to the Yangtze. A dragon dance winds through the old streets, dawn light falls through the eaves of the Yellow Crane Tower, and the city lights ignite along both banks at night.
calibration_note: Destination showcase. Featured noodles = direct home; place-as-destination = aspirational. Impossible FPV camera is cinematography, not fantasy.

title: Guangzhou — Teahouse to Tower
summary: Steam rises off dim sum in an old teahouse and the city answers — a lion dance leaping through the lanes, dawn on the carved timber of the ancestral hall, and a headlong FPV climb around the Canton Tower as the Pearl River burns with neon.
calibration_note: Sibling of Wuhan (same template, city+dish swapped). Identical verdict — gate is stable across a template family. TEMPLATE-FAMILY: china-city-portrait.

title: Beach BBQ — Signature Sauce
summary: Golden hour on a tropical beach. A woman lays out fresh ingredients, pours a glossy sweet-soy sauce over chicken skewers, brushes each one, and grills them over open flame. She sits with the sea behind her and takes the first bite. The sauce pouch rests on the board among the skewers.
render_stack: 8K realism; shallow DOF; premium food-CM styling
fix_note: Exact sauce label across 4 parts + one consistent face across 4 generations. Both are standard failure points.
calibration_note: Purest 'this is the product' sample. Direct food home at full strength. Food-ad enthusiasm is genre-honest — does NOT trip the authenticity gate.

title: The Pour — Latte Art
summary: Morning light through a café window. Espresso falls like molten lava under thick golden crema, milk spins to silk in the pitcher, and a galloping horse forms on the surface of the cup. The focus shifts from the art to the barista's quiet satisfaction.
render_stack: 85mm; shallow DOF; volumetric light; ASMR sound design
fix_note: Crema texture and the horse pattern forming cleanly are the two beats that decide the clip.
calibration_note: Strongest form of the direct home: food + venue + staff all in frame. Model of a disciplined shot-list prompt.

title: POV: Your Cat Runs a Michelin Restaurant
summary: An orange cat in a chef's hat runs a Michelin kitchen at peak service — chopping, flipping pans, salting like a celebrity chef, silently screaming at the humans. It pauses, stares down the camera, then plates a perfect pasta while the dining room stands and weeps.
render_stack: Pixar-quality realism; realistic fur physics; meme pacing
fix_note: Cat performing fine human motor tasks is the hardest ask in the set. Meme subtitles render unreliably — overlay in post. 'Gordon Ramsay energy' is referenced, not depicted; do not name or show him.
calibration_note: ANCHOR. An animal in a HUMAN HOSPITALITY ROLE keeps — the inverse of a person becoming a non-human being. Honest absurd comedy is not the fake-contrived cut.

title: Chef vs Raccoon
summary: A cheerful chef carries a giant pepperoni pizza across a sunny backyard. A raccoon challenges him for it. After a lunge, a flip and a furious tug-of-war, the box snaps and the pizza lands squarely on a sleeping bulldog's head. The bulldog opens one eye.
calibration_note: Reinforces the animal-around-food keep and the honest-comedy scope guard. Slotted in with no new rule needed.
